About.label: About Us
About.title: A Trusted Logistics Partner for Your Business
About.subtitle: Transit is a freight forwarding and goods transport company that has served the Jakarta-Bandung route since 2001. With over two decades of experience in land transportation and logistics, we understand your business's need for efficient, safe, and reliable shipping. We handle a wide range of cargo — from industrial raw materials and manufactured goods to general merchandise — all delivered to the highest standards of safety and punctuality.

FAQ.label: Common Questions
FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
FAQ.subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions about our Jakarta-Bandung freight and goods transport services.

items.q: How much does Jakarta-Bandung freight shipping cost?
items.a: The cost of shipping on the Jakarta-Bandung route (both ways) varies depending on the type of goods, volume, and weight. We offer competitive rates for both regular and express shipping, whether from Jakarta to Bandung or the other way around. Contact us via WhatsApp to get the best price quote for your shipping needs.

items.q: How long does shipping take on the Jakarta-Bandung route (both ways)?
items.a: Regular shipping takes 1-2 business days, while our express service can deliver the same day depending on pickup time — this applies in both directions, whether from Jakarta to Bandung or the other way around. We run a fixed daily shipping schedule to make sure your goods arrive on time.

items.q: What types of goods can be shipped?
items.a: We handle a wide range of goods, including industrial raw materials, manufactured goods, electronics, textiles, machine spare parts, office equipment, and general merchandise. For goods requiring special handling, please consult with our team first.

items.q: Do you offer pickup from the sender's location?
items.a: Yes, we provide door-to-door pickup from your location in Jakarta, Tangerang, Serpong (BSD), Bekasi, or from Greater Bandung. Our team picks up your goods according to the agreed schedule and delivers them directly to the destination address — whether that's Bandung City and the surrounding area, or back to the Greater Jakarta area.

items.q: Does Transit ship from Tangerang and Serpong (BSD) to Bandung?
items.a: Yes, our pickup coverage includes Jakarta, Tangerang, and Serpong (BSD), and the surrounding areas. Your goods are picked up directly from your location and shipped to Bandung City and Greater Bandung by land. This service runs both ways, from Tangerang-Serpong to Bandung and back.

items.q: How do you guarantee the safety of goods during shipping?
items.a: The safety of your goods is our top priority. Every shipment is handled by an experienced, professional team. Goods are packed and loaded to a high safety standard. Our truck fleet is well-maintained and properly secured. With over 25 years of experience, we have an excellent track record for shipping safety.

items.q: Can you ship goods from Bandung to Jakarta?
items.a: Yes, we offer two-way shipping: from Jakarta-Tangerang-Serpong to Bandung and back. Our route covers Jakarta, Tangerang, Serpong (BSD), through to Bandung City and Greater Bandung. Contact us for more information on schedules and rates.

Yes, B2B is our core service — covering the logistics needs of factories, manufacturing companies, distributors, and other businesses. We offer regular shipping contracts with fixed schedules, special rates for high volumes, and service tailored to your business's operational needs.

items.q: How long has Transit been in operation?
items.a: Transit (PT Transit Mega Raja) has been operating since 2001, making us one of the most experienced land freight companies on the Jakarta-Bandung route. With over 25 years of experience, we understand the ins and outs of logistics and shipping in the Jakarta-Bandung corridor.
